meta.protocol: walk-forward over every UFC bout since 1994 in date order (bout order inside a card); parameters chosen by coordinate descent on 2019-2023 log loss with the data stream cut at 2024-01-01; second-stage models by expanding-window CV by year inside 2019-2023; 2024-2025 scored once with the chosen settings; draws and no-contests excluded from winner metrics; event-clustered bootstrap (2000 resamples) for CIs
meta.test_window: test_2024_plus keys cover the validation years 2024-01-01..2025-12-31 only; fights from 2026-01-01 are the sealed vault (never scored; pre-fight probabilities exported outside the repo to ratings_vault.json)
meta.roster_note: roster = live state at the ufcstats snapshot (every fight through it, 2026 included), for the page and live matchups only; never use it to score past fights
meta.units: all ratings in log-odds (logit) units except TrueSkill (probit units, performance noise beta = 1); P(A) = sigmoid(kappa * (mu_A - mu_B)) for Elo; Glicko-2 and WHR shrink the difference by the combined uncertainty
meta.prediction_notes: predictions[fid].p: rating systems are prequential (each fight predicted from fights on earlier days only; their few parameters were tuned on 2019-2023, so 2019-2023 rows are in-window); dims = out-of-fold for 2019-2023 (expanding window by year, 2008+ rows always in training), full 2008-2023 fit for 2024+; stack = out-of-fold for 2020-2023, in-sample for 2019, 2019-2023 fit for 2024+; ratings_plus = 2019-2023 fit everywhere (use it only on 2024+). predictions[fid].r: pre-fight [mu_A, sd_A, mu_B, sd_B] per system (sd null for Elo); predictions[fid].dims: pre-fight [offence, defence] per dimension and side, log-rate units relative to the division baseline
meta.preufc_rule: pre-UFC newcomer prior applied only to UFC debuts on or after 2015-01-01 (complete, outcome-independent Sherdog coverage); older debuts use the age-only prior
preufc_features: feeder promotion graduates' UFC win rate: (promo_grad - 0.5) x 10
log1p(non-UFC wins over opponents with UFC experience)

elo_ref.label: Elo K=44 (x1.5 for the first 5 UFC fights): the project's existing baseline

elo_k.label: Elo, K schedule tuned (newcomer boost decaying with fights, layoff boost)

elo_full.label: Elo + margin of victory (method/round/decision type) + newcomer prior by age + skill trajectory (age curve, early-career learning, layoff)

elo_rounds.label: Round-level Elo: every round a game (judge-consensus round winners, stat model elsewhere), finishing round weighted, unplayed rounds to the finisher

glicko2.label: Glicko-2: rating deviation inflating with inactivity, volatility, newcomer prior, age drift, margin-weighted games

trueskill.label: TrueSkill-like Gaussian (probit) ratings, binary outcome, skill variance growing with time and per fight

trueskill_mov.label: TrueSkill with method-aware (ordinal) outcomes: finishes and unanimous decisions truncate the performance gap further out, split decisions to a band near zero

whr.label: Whole-History Rating (Bayesian Bradley-Terry, Gaussian random-walk skill, history re-solved before every fight day), binary outcomes

whr_mov.label: WHR with margin of victory (fractional / weighted outcomes by method)

whr_rounds.label: Round-level WHR: every round a game (judge-consensus winners), finishing and unplayed rounds to the finisher

whr_hybrid.label: WHR on a blend of the fight result with margin of victory and every round as a game (lam x fight + (1 - lam) x rounds)

dims.label: Dimensional ratings (striking volume/accuracy/power, takedowns, control, submissions; offence and defence per fighter, Kalman updates) -> logistic winner model

stack.label: Logistic stack of the rating systems (forward selection by time-ordered CV)

ratings_plus.label: Rating logits + pre-fight covariates (age gap, years past 34, reach, height, experience, layoff), forward selection by time-ordered CV; specified before the 2024+ results were seen

dim_baselines.note: league rate per division at the snapshot (exponentially weighted, ~300-fight memory); a fighter's expected rate vs an average opponent = baseline * exp(off), allowed vs an average attacker = baseline * exp(-def); acc is a probability on the logit scale

whr_rounds - whr.what: every round a game vs binary result (WHR)

whr_mov - whr.what: margin of victory vs binary result (WHR)

elo_full - elo_k.what: MOV + newcomer prior + age/layoff drift vs K-tuned Elo

glicko2 - elo_full.what: Glicko-2 vs Elo, same encoder and priors

whr_mov - elo_full.what: WHR vs Elo, same encoder and priors

stack - whr_rounds.what: stack (whr_rounds, glicko2, dims) vs best single
